Item 3.03. Material Modifications to Rights of Security Holders.

 

As previously disclosed, Strive, Inc. (the "Company") entered into an underwriting agreement (the “Underwriting Agreement”) with Barclays Capital Inc. and Cantor Fitzgerald & Co., as the joint book-running managers and representatives of the several underwriters, relating to the issuance and sale in an underwritten offering (the “Offering”) of 7,000,000 shares (the “Shares”) of the Company’s 15.00% Series A Perpetual SATS Preferred Stock, $0.001 par value per share (the “SATS Stock”).

 

In connection with the issuance of the SATS Stock, Strive filed a Certificate of Designation (the “Certificate of Designation”) with the Nevada Secretary of State on October 19, 2026 designating 17,000,000 shares, and establishing the terms, of the SATS Stock.

 

The SATS Stock accumulates cumulative dividends (“regular dividends”) at a rate per annum equal to 15.00% on the stated amount of $100 per share (the “stated amount”) thereof. Regular dividends will be payable when, as and if declared by Strive’s board of directors (“Board”) or any duly authorized committee thereof, out of funds legally available for their payment, in arrears for each regular dividend period on each regular dividend payment date to stockholders of record as of the close of business on the regular record date immediately preceding the applicable regular dividend payment date. Regular dividend dates will fall on each business day, as defined in the governing documentation for the SATS Stock, beginning on November 9, 2026. If declared in full, the first scheduled regular dividend on the SATS Stock payable will include all accrued and unpaid dividends from and after the closing date. No dividend, interest or other amount will accumulate or accrue on any unpaid regular dividends, regardless of whether regular dividends are declared for any future regular dividend period.
